newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.0 Aug 30 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.0 Aug 30 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) fell to 105.0 in the week ended August 30 from a revised 105.6 the previous week, ECRI said.

A drop in the growth rate of real estate loans and a rise in the insured unemployment rate contributed to the downward pressure of the inflation gauge, according to ECRI. But the smooth growth rate of industrial materials prices partly offset those downward pressures, ECRI said.
"We are not seeing much of an increase in inflationary pressures, but disinflationary tendencies among the leading inflation indicators have clearly ebbed in the last couple of months," ECRI said.
